preconditions.description: The number of rows in the city grid is at least 2 and at most 2000.
The number of columns in the city grid is at least 2 and at most 2000.
The time it takes for Dima to move between unoccupied cells is at least 1 and at most 10^9.
The value of each cell in the city grid is between -1 and 10^9, inclusive.
The destination cell (n, m) is free.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 if Dima cannot reach the school, or a non-negative integer representing the minimum time it will take for Dima to get to school.
